_about: Quiz bank for the US pack. Every answer cites its source. topic ids match the lessons.

questions.q: Which reporting category lets you distribute product made with a change as soon as FDA receives the supplement?
options: Supplement - Changes Being Effected in 30 Days
questions.why: A CBE (CBE-0) supplement allows distribution on FDA's receipt.

questions.q: What does FDA's guidance use to decide between a major, moderate and minor change?
options: The potential to have an adverse effect on identity, strength, quality, purity or potency
The number of CTD sections affected
questions.why: Categories follow substantial, moderate or minimal potential for an adverse effect on the product as it relates to safety or effectiveness.
questions.cite: Changes to an Approved NDA or ANDA, section II

questions.q: For a CBE-30, when can product made with the change first be distributed?
options: 30 days after FDA receives the supplement, unless FDA objects
questions.why: CBE-30 means the supplement is received at least 30 days before distribution.

questions.q: When is the annual report due?
options: Within 30 days of the anniversary of approval
Within 60 days of the anniversary of approval
questions.why: The annual report is due within 60 days of the anniversary date of approval.

questions.q: Several related changes fall in different categories. How should they be filed together?
options: Each in its own category, in one submission
In whatever category the applicant prefers
questions.why: FDA recommends filing related changes in the most restrictive of their individual categories.
questions.cite: Changes to an Approved NDA or ANDA, section XII

questions.q: Which regulation sets the categories for changes to a BLA?
questions.why: Biologics licensed under the PHS Act follow 601.12.

questions.q: Which section applies 314.70 to ANDAs?
questions.why: 314.97 makes ANDA holders follow 314.70 for changes.

questions.q: Is a PDUFA goal date a legal deadline for FDA to approve a supplement?
options: Yes, the supplement is approved automatically after it
No, it is a performance goal FDA commits to meeting for most submissions
questions.why: User fee goals are commitments to act on a share of submissions within a time; they are not statutory approval deadlines.

questions.q: A tablet moves to a site FDA has never inspected for that type of operation. Category?
questions.why: A new site never inspected for the operation makes the move a major change.
questions.cite: Changes to an Approved NDA or ANDA, VI.B.1

questions.q: An immediate-release tablet moves to a site with a satisfactory CGMP inspection for that operation. Category?
questions.why: A move not otherwise provided for is a moderate change: CBE-30.

questions.q: Why is the same move a prior approval supplement for an extended-release capsule?
options: Its formulation modifies the rate of availability
Extended-release products have longer shelf lives
Because a bioequivalence study is always needed
questions.why: Moves of products whose formulation modifies release are major changes.

questions.q: Moving secondary packaging (cartoning) to another site is:
questions.why: Secondary packaging moves are minor changes.

questions.q: Moving manufacture of the final intermediate of a drug substance to another site is:
questions.why: The guidance lists it as a CBE supplement.

questions.q: A testing site move is a CBE-30 when the lab uses approved procedures, commitments are met, and...
options: it is in the same country
it has the capability to do the testing
it was inspected in the last year
questions.why: Those three conditions make a testing site move a CBE-30.

questions.q: Aseptic filling moves to a newly built aseptic area. Category?
questions.why: New or refurbished aseptic facilities need prior approval.

questions.q: A terminally sterilized product moves to another building on the same site. Category?
questions.why: Same-site moves for terminally sterilized products are minor.

questions.q: Changing from wet granulation to direct compression is:
questions.why: A fundamental change in manufacturing technology is a major change.

questions.q: Replacing a blender with one of the same design and operating principle is:
questions.why: Equipment of the same design and operating principle is minor.

questions.q: For an immediate-release tablet, a batch size increase with the same process is reported in:
questions.why: The 2004 guidance treats changes in scale as minor unless otherwise provided; it supersedes earlier SUPAC categories for scale.

questions.q: Which guidance still sets the categories for components and composition changes?
options: None; all composition changes are minor
questions.why: The 2004 guidance says the categories in earlier guidances such as SUPAC still apply to components and composition.
questions.cite: Changes to an Approved NDA or ANDA, section V

questions.q: Under SUPAC-IR, a Level 2 excipient change is filed as:
questions.why: SUPAC-IR Level 2 composition changes need a prior approval supplement with dissolution data.

questions.q: Adding an ink imprint with an ink not used in any CDER-approved product is:
questions.why: An ink new to approved products needs prior approval.

questions.q: Removing a debossed code from an immediate-release tablet is:
questions.why: Adding or deleting a pressed code on a solid that is not modified release is minor.

questions.q: A new reprocessing procedure for batches that fail specification is:
questions.why: Establishing a reprocessing procedure needs prior approval.

questions.q: Changing the sterilizing filter's pore size is:
questions.why: Filter material or pore size changes may affect sterility assurance.

questions.q: Tightening an acceptance criterion for a tablet is:
questions.why: Tightening of acceptance criteria is minor.

questions.q: Adding a new impurity test that gives more assurance is:
questions.why: An addition to a specification that increases assurance is a CBE supplement.

questions.q: Relaxing a dissolution criterion (not for a compendial change) is:
questions.why: Relaxing an acceptance criterion needs prior approval unless the guidance says otherwise.

questions.q: Relaxing a criterion only to comply with a USP monograph is:
questions.why: Relaxing or deleting to comply with an official compendium is a CBE-30.

questions.q: Changing a regulatory analytical procedure to one that gives less assurance is:
questions.why: Less assurance means a major change.

questions.q: Adding an alternative analytical procedure with the same or greater assurance is:
questions.why: Alternative procedures with equal or better assurance are minor.

questions.q: Making the alternative procedure the regulatory procedure is:
questions.why: Establishing a new regulatory procedure, including designating an alternative as regulatory, is major.

questions.q: Changing from a vial to a prefilled syringe for a sterile product is:
questions.why: Such changes may affect sterility assurance.

questions.q: Changing the tablet count in a multiple-unit bottle is:
questions.why: For non-sterile solids in multiple-unit containers it is minor.

questions.q: Adding or deleting a desiccant is:
questions.why: Desiccant changes are CBE supplements.

questions.q: Changing a metered-dose inhaler valve is:
questions.why: Packaging that controls the dose delivered needs prior approval.

questions.q: Extending shelf life with full data from production batches under the approved stability protocol is:
questions.why: For NDAs and ANDAs this is an annual report change.

questions.q: Reducing the shelf life to give more assurance is:
questions.why: The guidance lists it as a CBE-30.

questions.q: Changing the labeled storage conditions is:
questions.why: Storage condition changes in labeling need prior approval unless exempted.

questions.q: Adding an adverse reaction based on newly acquired information with reasonable evidence of a causal association:
options: Can be made on FDA's receipt of a CBE supplement
questions.why: Safety labeling that adds or strengthens information on that basis can go in as a CBE-0.

questions.q: A new indication is submitted as:
questions.why: New indications need prior approval with supporting clinical data.

questions.q: After an FDA notification under section 505(o)(4), how long does the holder have to respond?
questions.why: The holder has 30 days to submit a supplement with the change or a rebuttal.

questions.q: Adding a distributor's name to the labeling is:
questions.why: Editorial changes are reported annually.

questions.q: Why must an ANDA holder update its labeling when the RLD labeling changes?
options: To keep a CBE-30 clock running
Because ANDA labeling must be the same as the RLD's, with permitted differences
Because the RLD holder asks for it
questions.why: Generic labeling must match the reference listed drug except for permitted differences.

questions.q: How is a new comparability protocol for a future change submitted?
options: In a prior approval supplement (or the original application)
questions.why: Adding a comparability protocol is a major change.
questions.cite: Changes to an Approved NDA or ANDA XI.A.2; Comparability Protocols guidance (2022)

questions.q: What does an approved comparability protocol do for the change it covers?
options: Removes the need to report it
Lets it be reported in the lower category the protocol sets
questions.why: Once approved, the protocol justifies a reduced reporting category for the covered change.

questions.q: For a biologic, establishing a new master cell bank is:
questions.why: A new master cell bank needs prior approval.
questions.cite: CMC Changes to an Approved Application: Certain Biological Products (2021)

questions.q: For a biologic, changing a viral clearance step is:
questions.why: Changes to virus removal or inactivation need prior approval.

questions.q: Which form goes with an annual report for an NDA?
questions.why: Annual reports use Form FDA 2252; supplements use Form FDA 356h.

questions.q: Who sends letters to FDA when an NDA changes ownership?
options: Both the former and the new owner
Nobody; FDA learns from the annual report
questions.why: The former owner reports the transfer and the new owner commits to the application's conditions.
